info.title: API.SH: Printables
info.description: The Printables API from API.SH: public Printables data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
One Printables model: name, summary, description, rating and rating count, likes, downloads, views, makes, comments, remixes, collections, tags, licence, print settings (print time, pieces, weight, nozzle, layer heights, materials, printer), every image, every file (models, G-codes with their settings, SLA and other files) with sizes and previews, the instructions PDF, remix sources, category, price and designer. NSFW-flagged models answer 404.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/printables-model

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Model id or a printables.com/model/<id>-<slug> link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Comments on a Printables model, oldest first, with their replies: text, date, likes, images, whether it is a make (a print someone posted), and the author. `makes_only=true` keeps the makes. Pass `next_offset` back as `offset`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/printables-model-comments

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Model id or a printables.com/model/<id> link.

parameters.name: makes_only
parameters.description: true: only comments that are makes.

get.description:
Printables' browse lists without keywords: trending, newest, recently updated, popular this week or month, most liked, most downloaded, most makes or top rated; per category, printer, featured or designer. NSFW-flagged models are left out. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/printables-models

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: trending (default), newest, recently_updated, popular_7_days, popular_30_days, most_liked, most_downloaded, most_makes or top_rated.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Only this designer's models: user id, @handle or profile link.

get.description:
3D models on Printables for keywords, with the site's filters: ordering, category, free/paid/club, has makes, featured, AI-generated, printers, materials and recency. Each model: id, name, link, image, rating, likes, downloads, makes, dates, multi-material and AI flags, price, category path and designer. NSFW-flagged models are left out. Pass `next_offset` back as `offset`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/printables-search

parameters.name: ordering
parameters.description: best_match (default), popular, latest, rating or makes_count.

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
